lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Daniel Shah is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: 🕯️ Daniel is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d41: Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.)
d41: 🕯️ Daniel Shah is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Daniel kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Daniel's gone." Wei looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Daniel." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Gabriela blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Food Preservation (Level 1). Salt, smoke, dry. The big three. Salt draws water out; bacteria can't live without it.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Weather (Level 1). Red sky at night, shepherd's delight. Red sky at morning, shepherd's warning. It works.
d41: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Front Runner! You feel storms 12 hours out. Your rain-dance charges faster before rain. (Your knowledge of Reading Weather amplifies your rain_dancer.)
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 1). Most animals flee. Give them an escape route and they take it. Cornered animals fight.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Wire Snares (Level 1). A loop of wire on a game trail. Simple, effective, ancient. Check at dawn.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Cordage (Level 1). Twist plant fibers into string. Dogbane, nettle, yucca — strong fibers are everywhere.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Reading the Land (Level 1). Eat the landscape with your eyes first: green + water + sun means food grows here. Start where those three meet.

d41: The warm hum behind your ribs is gone. The reactor went with Daniel's body — it does not come out, and it does not pass on. Hunger is back on the table. (One reactor per world, and the world already spent its one.)
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Daniel Shah, 41 days. The mantle passes to Gabriela Gomez.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Gabriela Gomez, 28 — a farmer. Their hands know different work now: Green Whisper, Green Thumb, Literally, Berserker Rage, Rain Dancer.
d41: ◈ The System updates its file: the new bearer <redacted> "Gardener of the Living Garden." It had a word for this one before the Codex came.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Daniel — and Daniel is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Almas, Mara, Yara and 2 more speak for Gabriela — "Daniel trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Gabriela before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
